verdict.rationale: Aleph documents a connector library spanning ERP, HRIS and CRM, and consolidates that cross-system data into one data layer. Its headcount planning explicitly runs on live HRIS and ERP data, so headcount and the books do sit in the same model. Missing for 10: no named payroll or CRM connectors, no documented example of CRM pipeline data feeding financial models, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, payroll/HRIS and CRM connectors bring headcount and pipeline data into the same model as the books

citations.quote: Connector library across ERP, HRIS, CRM, billing, databases, and other business systems.
Headcount planning backed by live HRIS, ATS, ERP, and spreadsheet data.
Consolidate cross-system data using 150+ no-code integrations
smart logic to combine tables, run calculations, store metrics, and more.
